messages:
liz: quick sync — we need to lock down the tool-call result shape for the public API v1. customers are asking for deterministic extraction and we have to set launch criteria by EOW :calendar: 
omar: curious what constraints we care most about: human-readable vs strict typing vs size. also cost of parsing arbitrary outputs?
jasmin: from an eval/ML pov: typed schema is huge. even simple typed fields reduce hallucination surface. propose a minimal typed format: status + structured payload + optional raw_text.
mike: +1 for optional raw_text. some customers will want full trace for debugging and audits. keep it opt-in behind query param or header.
sara: product ask—major customers want ability to version schemas and get clear migration docs. if we ship v1, need compatibility rules and deprecation timeline.
omar: technical tradeoffs: streaming + function calls gets messy with typed payloads. streaming tokens then final structured result means we need a deterministic assembly step server-side. is that acceptable?
jasmin: we can do streaming for text-only paths, but for tool_call_result I'd prefer server-finalized JSON. simpler contract. example payload: ```json
{
  "tool_call_result": {
    "status": "ok|error|partial",
    "schema_version": "v1",
    "payload": { /* typed fields here */ },
    "raw": "optional unparsed output"
  },
  "metadata": { "elapsed_ms": 123, "model": "redwood-xxl" }
}
```
omar: that shape looks fine. question: do we mandate a top-level envelope key (tool_call_result) or let tools return any JSON and we wrap? wrapping simplifies routing and validation.
liz: product decision: mandate envelope for v1 to enforce validation server-side. customers can opt into passthrough later. launch criteria: schema validation in SDKs, end-to-end examples, and migration guide.
sara: action items: PMs to draft migration doc, eng to implement server-side validator, SDK team to expose typed client classes. target: beta next sprint, GA in 6 weeks.
mike: infra note: validator needs to be aware of schema_version and support fast path for cached schema. also logging for invalid responses (sanitized) for SRE/audit.
deploy-bot: reminder: create incident channel if we see >1% invalid-tool-call responses in prod after rollout.
liz: cool. can each owner drop a short PR description in this thread by EOD? i'll collate for roadmap update. :thumbsup:
